daplog_begin.tooltip: Talks to the micro:bit V2 interface chip and exposes the log as MYDATA.CSV on the MICROBIT USB drive, ready to open in Excel/WPS. Formats the storage automatically on first use or when old-version/foreign data is found (existing log data is erased).

daplog_log_row.tooltip: Container block: however many add-column blocks you put inside, that many columns are written to MYDATA.CSV in order.

daplog_add_col.tooltip: Appends one column to the enclosing log row. Text, numbers and sensor readings can be plugged in directly.

daplog_log_row1.tooltip: Appends a single-column CSV line to MYDATA.CSV.

daplog_log_row2.tooltip: Appends a two-column CSV line to MYDATA.CSV.

daplog_log_row4.tooltip: Appends a four-column CSV line to MYDATA.CSV.

daplog_log_row5.tooltip: Appends a five-column CSV line to MYDATA.CSV.

daplog_log_row6.tooltip: Appends a six-column CSV line to MYDATA.CSV.

daplog_clear.tooltip: Erases all log data and rewrites the format marker line (file configuration is kept).

daplog_remount.tooltip: Makes the computer re-read the MICROBIT drive so the latest MYDATA.CSV content and size show up immediately.

daplog_ready.tooltip: True after successful initialization while the interface chip responds. micro:bit V2 only.

daplog_used_bytes.tooltip: Number of bytes written to the log (including the CSV marker line).

daplog_row_count.tooltip: Rows successfully written with the log-row block since the last power-on (rows before the reset are not counted).

daplog_status.tooltip: Returns diagnostics: err=failure step code (0=ok), ok=initialized, sec=sector bytes, cap=total capacity, used=bytes written, rows=rows this power-on. Print over serial to inspect.
